title: AutoVision Studio Release Model Manifest
description: Declares only fully approved, commercially-licensed C6 (Curated Base Weight) and C7 (Annotation Assist Model) payloads. Fail-closed: unknown license, unverified commercial use, unapproved status, or path traversal causes validation failure. Represents a release manifest, not a model registry or candidate list. An empty models array is valid and expected while G-DEP-07/G-DEP-08 approval gates are pending (docs/dependency-policy.md §12, FR-LIC-004/014).
$comment: JSON Schema enforces release composition, approved-entry fields, support coverage, and structural fail-closed rules. The PKG-01 release verifier must additionally verify model ID uniqueness, sourcePath file existence and SHA-256/byteSize, sourcePath-to-payloadPath package mapping, adoption/evidence file existence and SHA-256, required evidence-kind coverage, SPDX expression or canonical license URL validity, approval-record consistency, and confidenceThreshold compatibility with scoreRange.

schemaVersion.description: Must match this schema document version.

productVersion.description: Semantic version of the product release this manifest is bundled with. Omit before first release.

releaseStatus.description: Explicit declaration of release readiness. ready:false blocks G-DEP-07/G-DEP-08.

ready.description: Set to true only when all required C6/C7 approvals exist and the models array is non-empty.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of the current gate state.

models.description: Approved model entries only. The array is empty before any approval and may contain a partial approved set while releaseStatus.ready is false. A ready release requires C6 and C7 entries for both classification and detection. Uniqueness of 'id' across entries is enforced by the release verifier because JSON Schema cannot express uniqueness by one object property.

modelEntry.description: A single fully approved model payload. All fields must be known and verified; no 'unknown' values are permitted (fail-closed, docs/dependency-policy.md §3).

id.description: Unique lowercase kebab-case identifier for this model entry.

category.description: C6 = Curated Base Weight; C7 = Annotation Assist Model checkpoint (docs/dependency-policy.md §1).

task.description: ML task: image classification (top-k) or object detection (box+class+score).

name.description: Official model name as listed in the adoption record.

version.description: Model version, tag, or commit hash as listed in the adoption record.

downloadUrl.description: Original HTTPS acquisition URL for provenance only (FR-LIC-004/014). The application and build must never download this URL at runtime.

retrievedDate.description: ISO 8601 date on which the exact payload was acquired.

sourcePath.description: Build-machine source path for the approved untracked model binary under vendor/models/ (D-09). PKG-01 verifies this file before packaging.

payloadPath.description: Packaged destination path under resources/models/. PKG-01/PKG-04 must copy the verified sourcePath bytes to this path without changing sha256 or byteSize.

sha256.description: Exact lowercase hex SHA-256 digest of the payload file at payloadPath (FR-LIC-004/014).

byteSize.description: Exact file size of the payload in bytes. Must be greater than zero.

format.description: Safe serialization format. Pickle full-model is prohibited (FR-SEC-007).

evidence.description: Local saved copies of primary sources underpinning each license and approval decision, with SHA-256 for future verification (FR-LIC-004/014).

support.description: Exactly the four required verified OS/provider combinations: Windows CPU/DirectML and macOS CPU/CoreML (POC-03/08).

licenseSet.description: Three independent license layers assessed separately (docs/dependency-policy.md §4, FR-LIC-005/015). Code approval does not imply checkpoint approval.

checkpoint.description: Weight file license, assessed independently from code (C6/C7 layer).

trainingData.description: All public training datasets. C7 requires full enumeration (FR-LIC-014). Each dataset's terms must confirm commercial use of derivative models.

spdxLicense.description: License assertion for a single layer (code or checkpoint). All fields must be confirmed; no unknown or unconfirmed values (docs/dependency-policy.md §3).

spdx.description: SPDX identifier (e.g., 'Apache-2.0') or canonical license URL for non-SPDX licenses. 'unknown' and 'NOASSERTION' are rejected (fail-closed, docs/dependency-policy.md §3).

commercialUseConfirmed.description: Commercial use explicitly confirmed. false is not a valid value for an approved entry (fail-closed).

redistributionPermitted.description: Redistribution explicitly permitted. false is not a valid value for an approved entry (fail-closed).

noticeText.description: Full attribution or NOTICE text required by this license. Empty string if no attribution obligation.

datasetLicense.description: License and terms for a single training dataset (C8 layer). Commercial use of derivative models must be explicitly confirmed.

datasetName.description: Dataset name as listed in the adoption record (e.g., 'ImageNet-21k', 'COCO 2017').

termsUrl.description: Original HTTPS URL of the dataset terms used for the decision (FR-LIC-004/014).

termsRetrievedDate.description: ISO 8601 date on which the dataset terms were retrieved and saved.

commercialDerivativesPermitted.description: Commercial use of models trained on this dataset is explicitly confirmed. false is not valid (fail-closed). ImageNet and COCO require individual legal review (FR-LIC-006/007).

redistributionConditions.description: Confirmed conditions that apply when redistributing the trained checkpoint, or an explicit statement that no additional conditions apply.

attributionText.description: Required attribution text for this dataset. Empty string if no attribution obligation.

evidenceEntry.description: A local saved copy of a primary source document used to establish license or approval decisions. Must be retained so decisions can be re-verified if the original URL disappears (FR-LIC-004/014).

kind.description: Classification of this primary source document.

sourceUrl.description: Original HTTPS URL of the primary source. This is provenance metadata and is never fetched by the application at runtime.

localPath.description: Path to the local saved copy under docs/model-governance/. Each path component must begin with alphanumeric, underscore, or hyphen — prevents '..' traversal.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the local saved copy, for future re-verification.

retrievedDate.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the source was retrieved and saved.

approvalRecord.description: Reference to the completed adoption record and the approver who signed off. status must be 'Approved'; candidates and pending entries must not appear in this manifest.

recordPath.description: Path to the completed adoption record file (docs/dependency-policy.md §6, template: docs/model-governance/<slug>-<version>-adoption.md).

status.description: Must be exactly 'Approved'. Any other value — including 'Pending', 'Rejected', or 'Candidate' — is invalid in this manifest (fail-closed).

approver.description: Name of the approver who signed off on the adoption record.

intendedUseRecord.description: Confirmed assessment of the model card's intended and out-of-scope use fields against this product's use case (FR-LIC-014/015).

productUseInScope.description: Product use must be within the model card's stated intended use. false is not valid (fail-closed, FR-LIC-014).

outOfScopeProductionUse.description: Production or deployed use must not appear in the model card's out-of-scope list. true is not valid (fail-closed, FR-LIC-015; e.g., CLIP is excluded on this basis).

supportEntry.description: Verification result for one OS and Execution Provider combination (POC-03/08). DirectML applies to windows-x64; CoreML applies to macos-arm64.

verified.description: Must be true because only fully approved entries may appear in this release manifest.

inferenceConfig.description: Required for C7 (Annotation Assist Model). Defines confidence threshold and determinism guarantees needed for candidate reproducibility (NFR-ANN-004).

scoreMeaning.description: Model-specific meaning, unit, range, and calibration limitations of the displayed score. It must not describe the score as a probability of correctness unless that claim is separately validated (FR-AST-012).

minimum.description: Inclusive minimum score emitted by the approved model contract.

maximum.description: Inclusive maximum score emitted by the approved model contract. PKG-01 verifies minimum <= maximum.

confidenceThreshold.description: Inclusive lower bound (score >= threshold) used only to generate or display a model suggestion. It must fall within scoreRange, as verified by PKG-01. It never approves a suggestion or marks an image as confirmed; every candidate still requires individual human review (FR-AST-010/011/013).

thresholdPolicy.description: Versioned, model-specific policy and PoC evidence reference from which the candidate-generation threshold was selected (FR-AST-013).

deterministicInference.description: true if inference is reproducible given identical inputs, payload, preprocess parameters, and seed values (NFR-ANN-004).

nonDeterministicOperations.description: Names of non-deterministic operations when deterministicInference is false. Must be documented in the manifest and POC report.

seeds.description: Named integer seed values for reproducible inference (e.g., {"torch": 42, "numpy": 42}).
